name: Core Framework & Modular Foundation
description: Build the essential framework with modular installation system before adding business features
objectives: Establish solid foundation with Laravel Jetstream Teams
Create robust module installation and management system
Build core UI shell and navigation framework
Implement basic security and tenant isolation
Create testing framework for validating modules

milestones.name: Laravel Foundation Setup
milestones.description: Core Laravel application with Jetstream Teams
deliverables: Laravel application with Jetstream Teams authentication
Basic database schema for users, teams, roles

milestones.name: Module Management System
milestones.description: Core module installation and management framework

milestones.name: UI Shell & Navigation
milestones.description: Base UI framework that modules can extend
deliverables: Dynamic navigation system (modules register menu items)
Responsive layout with mobile PWA foundation

milestones.name: Core Security & Settings
deliverables: File upload security with Spatie Media Library

milestones.name: Testing Framework & Validation
milestones.description: Create first test modules to validate the system

success_criteria: Can install/uninstall modules without core code changes
Data is properly isolated between teams
UI adapts dynamically based on installed modules
All tests pass for core framework and test modules

technical_requirements.testing_approach: Pest with focus on integration tests

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Module system too complex for initial implementation
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Start with simple file-based modules, iterate to more sophisticated system

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Performance impact of dynamic module loading
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Cache module configurations, lazy load components
Strict validation of module manifests, sandboxed installation process
